integrity_note: During the first J4 schedule search, post-match search snippets exposed that Pachuca won its J4 match and that Tijuana drew. J4 is therefore permanently NO-PROMOTION. The statistical packet itself contains only information available before J4 and completed J1-J3 league results.

league_snapshot_through_j3.uneven_games_played_note: Tigres and Guadalajara have played only two Liga MX matches because their J1 fixture was postponed.

pre_j4_context_signals: Pachuca is the only 3-0-0 Liga MX team entering J4.
Tigres, Cruz Azul and América also enter J4 unbeaten in Liga MX, with Tigres on only two league matches.
Liga MX paused after J3 for the Leagues Cup first phase and resumes J4 from August 8-11, creating heterogeneous rest, travel, minutes and rotation exposure across clubs.
Leagues Cup performance/minutes may be useful as contextual information but are not inputs to the frozen Dixon-Coles Liga MX model unless separately preregistered.
Current-tournament home/away splits are extremely small samples and must remain descriptive rather than automatic numeric adjustments.

source_policy.league_stats: Computed only from completed Apertura 2025 J1-J3 Liga MX results already frozen before J4.
source_policy.fixture_schedule: Pre-match schedule sources published before J4 kickoff were used for fixture identity and timing.
source_policy.context: Only information demonstrably public before each fixture kickoff may be admitted. Post-match facts are excluded from selection logic even though researcher exposure disqualifies J4 from promotion.
